text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash needs to build experience, but not by constantly running scrimmages. No, what she needs is to compete with a Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After coming to this conclusion, I seek Symboli Rudolf for help. She suggests I ask Mr. C.B., a Triple Crown champion, for partner running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. readily agrees and defeats Eishin Flash almost effortlessly. The race gives her firsthand experience of what it takes to win the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Specifically, it's "the desire to win," and though she questions Mr. C.B.'s abstract advice, Eishin Flash seems to have learned something from it.
